label: Necessary (2)
resolution: In the tertia via 'necessary' is said of beings: a being that cannot not-be. A necessary being may have its necessity from another (the dichotomy STMT-NECESSARY-HAS-CAUSE-OF-NECESSITY-OR-NOT leaves both cases open), so 'necessary per se' is a further condition, and the tertia via's conclusion and its convergence with the maxime ens (STMT-NECESSARY-PER-SE-IS-MAXIME-ENS) are about necessary per se beings. Logical necessity of a proposition is not used: excluded middle (STMT-EXCLUDED-MIDDLE) is a logical principle, not a claim that any being exists necessarily. Scott's variant (#134) uses two further senses. 'Necessarily' there is the Kripke box of the QML KB embedding (DEF-QML-KB-NECESSITY), said of propositions relative to an accessibility relation. 'Necessary existence' (DEF-NECESSARY-EXISTENCE-SCOTT) is a property of individuals defined from essences and that box. Neither is the tertia via's necessary being as such; their relation to it is fixed by the sense fork below. Gödel's 1970 variant (#135) has the same Kripke box over its own embedding (DEF-HOML-ACTUALIST-NECESSITY, the shared Lean `Box`) and its own 'necessary existence' (DEF-NECESSARY-EXISTENCE-GOEDEL-1970), defined from the 1970 essence and the actualist quantifier. It is not Scott's necessary existence: the two are separate Lean declarations. `FilteredNecessaryExistence` (DEF-FILTERED-NECESSARY-EXISTENCE) is a stipulated diagnostic variant, using the same property filter for both essence quantifiers; its model-theoretic outcomes must not be attributed to Scott or equated with a Thomistic necessary being. The arbitrary-frame fixture (DEF-MODAL-FIXTURE-FRAME) shares the raw Box operator with the KB embedding; KB symmetry and quantifier policies are separate framework premises. Kant’s stipulated de re NecessaryAt is that Box applied to the existence of one fixed object under the same frame (DefinitionDictionaryConnections.connections), while NecessaryBeing also requires an actual witness. This dictionary equality does not identify source concepts or change existential scope. Sense fork (owner direction 2026-11-07): for the necessary-classical-God route the senses are related by TruthCore.Causality.NecessarySenseFork (DEF-NECESSARY-IN-SENSE), a finite enum with NecessaryIn defined by cases, and by the fork theorem NECESSARY-SENSE-FORK (forkOnIntendedReading). The route's NecessaryAt is the Kripke box of 'n exists' by Iff.rfl (necessaryAt_iff_boxExistsAt), so the route already uses modal-logic necessity, in logic K. Branches that succeed from the 25 route inputs alone: box-existence in K (STMT-NECESSARY-ROOT-BOX-K), actualist K (STMT-NECESSARY-ROOT-ACTUALIST-K), de dicto K (STMT-NECESSARY-ROOT-DE-DICTO-K) and tertia via 'cannot not-be' with possibility read as the frame's diamond (STMT-NECESSARY-ROOT-TERTIA-VIA). Branches that succeed given a side condition and fail without it (countermodels in NECESSARY-SENSE-FORK-CONTROLS): box-existence in KT, S4, KTB and S5 (the OPEN frame premises STMT-ONTIC-FRAME-KT, -S4, -KTB, -S5) and necessary per se (the OPEN grounding premises STMT-NECESSITY-CAUSE-RELATA-ACTUAL-CONCRETE, STMT-NECESSITATED-DEPENDS-ON-ITS-CAUSE, STMT-ACTUAL-DEPENDENCE-IS-GROUNDING). No enumerated branch is refuted. Unresolved and left out of the enum, so open to attack through the coverage premise STMT-NECESSARY-SENSES-EXHAUSTIVE: logical necessity of existence and the essence-based Scott, Goedel-1970 and filtered necessary existence. The exclusivity premise STMT-NECESSARY-SENSE-UNIQUE is a choice of one reading, not disjointness of extensions; the strength order is registered by strengthens relations (S5 -> S4 -> T -> actualist K -> K -> de dicto K and tertia via; S5 -> KTB -> T; per se -> tertia via). The root route NECESSARY-CLASSICAL-GOD-CASE-SENSE-FORK takes the sense as a parameter of its necessary root; within each argument the use of 'necessary' is the single sense its Lean statement names, so no argument passes between senses. NECESSARY_12 is the actualist K reading constrained to the route root: the same witness actually exists and is box-existent, with RootFacts. It is represented by NecessaryRootActualistK, not by the frame sense NECESSARY_11. The existence-sense-route batch derives this root node from NECESSARY_2 box-existence with RootFacts; this does not identify bare box-existence and actuality. LogicalNecessityProfiles adds scoped analyst siblings NECESSARY_13 (selected-frame full validity), NECESSARY_14 (all-small-frame K validity), NECESSARY_15 (stated local theory entailment). Their exact one-premise weakenings and strictness controls preserve the same formula language. None binds NECESSARY_5 or extends the existing root Sense enum. A theory-to-root bridge uses theory admission at the selected point and accessible cone, an explicit same-formula/same-bearer existence dictionary, and independent RootFacts. Satisfiability is witnessed in the joint model control, while inconsistent-theory triviality is rejected as truth evidence. These are conditional support options, not establishment, coverage or historical attribution. Sense audit (2026-11-20, attempt 'Audit of the senses of NECESSARY and the frame-to-schema bridges of the route box'; Lean status from truth definitions, relations by evidence). NECESSARY_2 (NecessaryAt, DEF-KANT-MODAL-NECESSITY): defined; de re box-existence of one fixed individual over the route frame, equal to the Kripke box of 'x exists' (necessaryAt_iff_boxExistsAt, Iff.rfl) and to the raw Box (DEFINITION-DICTIONARY-CONNECTIONS); logic K unless a frame premise is added. NECESSARY_3 (IsNecessary, DEF-NECESSARY-BEING): defined relative to a supplied possibility operator, which stays primitive by design (the tertia via's possibility over conditions on times); with possibility read as the frame's diamond the box-K node strengthens the tertia via node, and the converse needs excluded middle. NECESSARY_4 (IsNecessaryPerSe, DEF-NECESSARY-PER-SE): defined as NECESSARY_3 plus no cause of necessity from another; that cause relation is a supplied primitive; the per se node strengthens the tertia via node, and the per se branch needs the three OPEN grounding premises. NECESSARY_5 (DEF-LOGICAL-NECESSITY): no Lean declaration, primitive by design: 'denial is contradictory' is a family over a chosen logic, language and interpretation domain, and no single declaration is faithful to the generic sense. Its bounded instances are NECESSARY_13, NECESSARY_14 and NECESSARY_15, and the analyst contrast LogicalNecessityContrast.DenialContradictory (frame-relative unsatisfiable denial, classically equivalent to SelectedFrameValidity by denialContradictory_iff_valid). NECESSARY_6 (Scott NecessaryExistence): defined from essences and Box with possibilist constant-domain quantification; with full comprehension it holds of x at w exactly when every world accessible from w is w (SCOTT-NE-WORLD-ISOLATION), so it is a frame-local condition, not box-existence of x; no bridge to the route. NECESSARY_7 (FilteredNecessaryExistence): defined, a diagnostic variant; admissible = True gives Scott's NE, and the world-invariant filter differs from it (SCOTT-NE-INVARIANT-FILTER-COUNTERMODEL). NECESSARY_8 and NECESSARY_10 (GoedelGod.Box): one defined operator, the Kripke box over an arbitrary frame; they differ only in the embeddings' separate frame and quantifier commitments (KB, possibilist; S5 axiomatized, actualist), which are premises, not parts of the operator. The shared declaration stays a legacy allowance; a distinct declaration would have to bundle those commitments. NECESSARY_9 (Goedel 1970 NecessaryExistence): defined; the empty property is an essence of everything in the 1970 sense (GOEDEL-1970-EMPTY-PROPERTY-IS-ESSENCE), so it holds only where no world is accessible: this follows by unfolding and is not yet a recorded result; it is not Scott's NE (separate declarations). NECESSARY_11 (Modal.Frame, DEF-MODAL-FIXTURE-FRAME): a structure, the vocabulary container of the raw box (Holds, Valid, Box); no frame condition. The schema premises (T, 4, B, 5) carry the passage from this vocabulary to NECESSARY_2 as declared sense bridges. NECESSARY_12 (NecessaryRootActualistK): defined; logically equivalent to the box-K root node because RootFacts carries actuality; the box-T node strengthens it. NECESSARY_13, NECESSARY_14, NECESSARY_15: defined; AllFrameKValidity strengthens SelectedFrameValidity, which strengthens TheoryRelativeEntailment. No nomic or physical necessity sense is recorded: no root-route argument uses one. Frame-to-schema bridges (NECESSARY-SENSE-BRIDGES, #1784): the KT frame premise STMT-ONTIC-FRAME-KT is logically equivalent to the T schema STMT-ONTIC-T-SCHEMA (axiomT_valid forward, the verified T correspondence backward); the KTB frame premise strengthens the B schema and the S5 frame premise strengthens the 5 schema (axiomB_valid, axiom5_valid), both strictly (one-world frame without edges). The philosophical bridge that the cosmological argument's intended necessity is box-existence in S5 stays the OPEN reading premise STMT-INTENDED-BOX-S5 (and its KT, KTB and S4 siblings); it is not a definitional equality. Tautology (2026-11-22, TractarianLogicalSpace batch): NECESSARY_16 (Tautology) is truth of a box-free formula under every truth-value assignment to its atoms, said of formulas, not of beings. It strictly strengthens NECESSARY_14 (strength order, K axiom as strictness witness) and coincides with NECESSARY_14, and with NECESSARY_13 on any inhabited frame, on the truth-functional fragment; it is a bounded instance of NECESSARY_5 for classical truth-functional logic (contradictory denial, the converse with excluded middle as an explicit antecedent). In combinatorial logical space (547cac5c-7089-4bce-b5e7-bb8b6c8d12b9, every assignment realized at an accessible world) a box-free formula is boxed exactly when it is a NECESSARY_16 tautology ('only logical necessity'), and any box-free exact existence dictionary for a NECESSARY_2 box-existent bearer is a tautology. This does not pass from NECESSARY_16 to NECESSARY_2: the joint route model has, on one S5 frame, logical space and only logical necessity for the state-of-affairs valuation together with the NECESSARY_2 S5 necessary-being node. Only the further thesis that the candidates' existence facts are themselves free coordinates of logical space (ElementaryExistenceAt) conflicts with the box K node, which excludes it at the same world.
